firstRunResults.honestNote: The row was GREEN on its first complete run. The product already implements the behaviour; this is coverage, not a fix. Red-first was therefore not available, and discrimination is established by mutation instead (below).
firstRunResults.assertionOrderIsLoadBearing: The live host's per-viewer delivery is CAPTURED but not asserted against a literal until after the recovery assertions. An earlier draft asserted the live literal first, and mutation M1 then died on the LIVE path at line 235 without ever reaching the recovery claim - which is precisely the inference this row exists to replace. The order was changed so the RECOVERED delivery is the one compared against the literal first (line 259), and the live/recovered equality is the follow-on assertion (line 265).

mutationTable.intent: skip the detach/redaction on the recovery delivery
mutationTable.observedDiff: the RECOVERED host served every viewer both snapshots: owner got both, opponent got both, and the spectator ('watcher') got both instead of none
mutationTable.honestCaveat: There is NO recovery-only line to mutate: the redaction lives at a shared detach point that the live broadcast, the live replay and the recovery replay all reach through ServerMatchHostReplay. That shared-ness is exactly why line 6's recovery audience was 'inferred'. What M1 proves is the missing half of that inference - that the RECOVERY-path delivery actually executes that shared line - because the kill lands on the recovered host's own assertion, not on the live one.

residualsStillOpen.verdict: STILL OPEN - AND NOT CLOSABLE BY A TEST AT 4e5a74b9f
residualsStillOpen.finding: The rewind clause cannot be proven for ANY match, custom or canonical, because the boot-time rewind fold is structurally unreachable for a match stream on this head. A candidate branch cut from a mirrored match stream has parentBranchId 'main' (MATCH_BASELINE_BRANCH_ID), and matchStoreBranchSegmentReader refuses every branch id but 'root' by name.
evidenceChain: src/lib/multiplayer/server/MatchStreamJournalMirror.ts:165 - the mirror appends on `effective?.branchId ?? MATCH_BASELINE_BRANCH_ID`, and a match stream has no effective head before its first mirror, so EVERY mirrored match's journal events land on 'main'

src/lib/multiplayer/server/history/matchStoreBranchSegmentReader.ts:~128 - read() throws EventHistoryBranchError('unknown-branch', "A match store holds only the 'root' branch; '<id>' has no events") for any segment whose branchId is not ROOT_EVENT_BRANCH_ID
src/lib/multiplayer/server/ServerMatchHostRewindRebuild.ts:131-159 - tryFoldActivatedRewindBranch resolves the activated branch PATH, whose parent segment therefore names 'main', through that reader
src/lib/multiplayer/server/MatchRecovery.ts:192 - recoverActiveMatches calls tryFoldActivatedRewindBranch first, so the throw is caught at line 347 and the whole match lands in `failed`

probe.what: A unit-free repro: a match with TWO SYNTHETIC PhaseChanged events (no units, no custom construction, no canonical catalog) committed through appendCommandBatch at mode 'shadow', then rewound with the PRODUCTION calls - acquireCorrectionLease -> createCorrectionCandidateBranch (which also seeds the candidate's journal head at its base) -> sealArtifactManifest -> activateCandidateBranch -> supersedeFrom - and then folded.
probe.result: tryFoldActivatedRewindBranch REJECTED with EventHistoryBranchError: "A match store holds only the 'root' branch; 'main' has no events"
probe.source: rewind-fold-blocker.probe.ts (kept in the log directory only; it was copied into src/, run, and deleted - it is NOT in the commit and NOT in the repo)
probe.whyThisProbeSettlesIt: It shares zero code with custom construction. The failure is therefore NOT a defect of enable-saved-custom-unit-combat; it is a gap in the rewind machinery that line 5's text happens to name.

residualsStillOpen.ownershipAssessment: This belongs to `adopt-combat-journal-cutover-and-gm-rewind`, whose own tasks 2.1 / 2.3 / 2.5 / 3.1 (the moved umbrella 14.1 / 14.2 / 14.4 / 14.5 requirements) are ALL still unchecked at this head, and whose e2e rewind pack is tagged strict-expected-failure `@until-journal-cutover`. So the gap is consistent with that change's declared state rather than a regression against it. It is NOT, however, named anywhere in that change's artefacts: a grep for 'unknown-branch', "only the 'root' branch", 'matchStoreBranchSegmentReader' and "'main' has no events" across openspec/changes/adopt-combat-journal-cutover-and-gm-rewind/ returns ZERO hits in this session. Owner decision required.
residualsStillOpen.whatWouldCloseIt: Either (a) the journal-cutover change teaches matchStoreBranchSegmentReader to serve the baseline branch id as well as 'root' (the two name the same single line of history - matchAuthorityBaseline.ts's own LIVE_PATH_BRANCH_IDS comment already says so), or (b) the mirror lands match events on 'root'. Until one of those exists there is no rewound match session to recover a recorded construction from, so line 5's rewind clause has nothing to assert against. Both are product changes and were explicitly out of scope for this slice.

incidentalFindings.what: The S1 journal mirror cannot represent a REAL match launch. A live InteractiveSession's launch log carries explicitly-undefined optional properties, and the journal's JCS canonicalizer refuses them outright.
incidentalFindings.evidence: Calling mirrorMatchBatchToJournal with the in-memory events of a real buildMatchHostBootstrapFromMeta launch threw 'JCS cannot represent undefined'. A walk of those events named 9 undefined properties across the 2-event log: game_created.actorId, game_created.payload.config.seed, payload.units[0..1].movementMode / .initiativeEquipment / .c3Equipment, and game_started.actorId.
incidentalFindings.whyItIsLatent: DurableMatchStore.mirrorCommittedBatch is gated on getCombatJournalAuthorityMode() !== 'off' and the production mode is off, so this does not fire today. It also never fails the command - the throw is caught and recorded on the shadow tripwire as 'journal-mirror:JCS cannot represent undefined'.
incidentalFindings.whyItMatters: If the mode is flipped to 'shadow' for real traffic, EVERY match's launch batch would miss the mirror and bump the shadow mismatch counter, and the counter is what S6 consults before promoting the journal to authority. The mirror receives the caller's in-memory batch, not the round-tripped form the store persists.
incidentalFindings.workaroundUsedHere: The throwaway probe offered the batch as JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(events)) - exactly the shape mp_match_events holds, since the store writes JSON.stringify(event). This is scaffolding for the probe only; nothing in the committed row depends on it.
